title: Microsoft 365: Frontier program expands to preview features in Teams, Outlook, OneDrive and SharePoint
summary: Hold for corrections to licensing, the release exception limit and existing enrolments. The admin's Copilot licence requirement changes only when the unified experience reaches the tenant, the exception limit counts individual group members, and Learn already says enrolled users receive eligible previews as they are released.
